title: [review] tests.rs: Missing bounds check in test harness receive funct
description: MeshRadio::receive copies packet data without verifying packet.len() <= buf.len(). If a test ever queues a packet larger than the receive buffer, this will panic with 'slice index out of bounds' rather than returning an error. In practice this is unlikely since tests use MAX_FRAME_SIZE buffers and transmitted packets are size-limited, but defensive code would use buf.get_mut(..packet.len()) or check bounds first.
